questions.question: Define thermosphere. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Thermosphere is the layer of the Earth's atmosphere located directly above the mesosphere, characterized
  • by temperatures that increase significantly with altitude due to the absorption of high-energy solar
  • radiation. (Definition; 2 marks) [K] [CO2]

questions.question: What is algal bloom? / [CO4] [2x7 = 14]
questions.solution_html:
• Algal bloom is a rapid increase or accumulation in the population of algae in freshwater or marine water
  • systems, often resulting in a visible green, red, or brown discoloration of the water surface (Definition; 2
  • marks). [U] [CO4]
